name: OPPSTAR
recent: Oppstar 在 2026 年 11 月 11 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，并签署一份谅解备忘录。此前，公司多名董事及主要股东在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间多次申报买卖持股。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 11 日签署一份谅解备忘录。
公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
risks: 联席首席执行官 Cheah Hun Wah 于 2026 年 10 月多次申报出售股份。
首席运营官 Tan Chun Chiat 于 2026 年 10 月申报出售股份。
首席财务官 Chin Fung Wei 于 2026 年 9 月至 10 月申报股份转让及出售。

recent_en: Oppstar released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 and signed a memorandum of understanding on 11 November 2026. Prior to that, several directors and substantial shareholders filed multiple notifications of share dealings between September and October 2026.
notable_en: The company signed a memorandum of understanding on 11 November 2026.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Co-Chief Executive Officer Cheah Hun Wah filed multiple notifications of share disposals in October 2026.
Chief Operating Officer Tan Chun Chiat filed notifications of share disposals in October 2026.
Chief Financial Officer Chin Fung Wei filed notifications of share transfers and disposals in September and October 2026.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter (2026-06-30), revenue was MYR 15,864,000 and net income was MYR 4,094,000, with a net margin of 25.8%; revenue grew 51.0% QoQ and 99.4% YoY, while the previous quarter's net margin was -63.3%.
